definitions.explanation: A meal or food in general (casual/masculine speech).

examples.english: Let's eat. / Let's grab some food.
examples.notes: 飯を食う = to eat (casual, masculine)

notes:
USAGE: {飯|めし} is a casual, somewhat masculine word for meals or cooked rice. In polite or formal contexts, use {食事|しょくじ} (meal) or {ご飯|ごはん} (rice/meal).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{飯|めし}を{食|く}う (to eat - very casual)
・{朝|あさ}{飯|めし} (breakfast - casual)
・{昼|ひる}{飯|めし} (lunch - casual)
・{晩|ばん}{飯|めし}/{夕|ゆう}{飯|めし} (dinner - casual)
・{飯|めし}にしよう (let's eat)

REGISTER: Casual/masculine. The polite equivalent is ご{飯|はん}.

CONTRAST:
・{飯|めし} - casual, masculine
・ご{飯|はん} - neutral to polite
・{食事|しょくじ} - formal, neutral
